task: Passing a file-like wrapper object that forwards attributes with __getattr__ (including iteration support) as data= is not treated as a stream when the request body is prepared. It is handled as the wrong body type, and for example a redirect that must re-send such a streamed body misbehaves. Such wrappers should be streamed exactly like the underlying file.
setup: uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest pytest-httpbin pytest-mock trustme pytest-timeout
